# ui::glyphs

Namespace-scope declarations of `ui::glyphs` from the rendering headers.

Names for the glyphs the library's controls use. It is not Segoe Fluent Icons' full catalog.

An app that needs a glyph the table doesn't name declares its own: [IconGlyph](icon-glyph.md) is a plain aggregate, so a codepoint from the Segoe Fluent Icons catalog is all it takes, and it works everywhere a `glyphs::` constant does.

```cpp
constexpr ui::IconGlyph ZoomIn{0xE8A3};  // ZoomIn
constexpr ui::IconGlyph ZoomOut{0xE71F}; // ZoomOut
```
